title: English Reading Support
want: A group of 12 students from class 6 to 8 would like help to read English aloud with confidence.
serveUsWell: No photos, please. Come on time every Saturday. The students may take time to open up, so listen before you correct and let them choose the story.
youWillLearn: The students can teach you a local game, and how patience helps a young reader find their own voice.
